inspiration.observed_pattern: A NATURAL LEFT JOIN combines two derived relations, inferring equality from their shared columns while preserving unmatched rows from the left relation.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as a warehouse-bin inventory report. Two independently authored derived tables share bin_id and zone_code; NATURAL LEFT JOIN matches only rows agreeing on both names, while a missing or zone-mismatched stock row produces NULL right-side values. The source tables, aliases, columns, and test data are not copied.

fixture_notes: Bin 601 matches stock on both bin_id and zone_code and returns assigned_count 4. Bin 602 has a same-ID stock row with a different zone and must remain NULL-extended; bin 603 has no stock row and must also remain NULL-extended.
determinism_notes: Bin IDs, zone codes, capacities, assignment counts, and ordering are fixed; both derived relations are read-only and the query uses no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules.
setup: CREATE TABLE warehouse_bin_catalog (bin_id INT PRIMARY KEY, zone_code VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, capacity_units INT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE warehouse_bin_assignments (bin_id INT PRIMARY KEY, zone_code VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, assigned_units INT NOT NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT catalog.bin_id, catalog.zone_code, catalog.capacity_units, assignments.assigned_units FROM (SELECT bin_id, zone_code, capacity_units FROM warehouse_bin_catalog WHERE capacity_units > 0) AS catalog NATURAL LEFT JOIN (SELECT bin_id, zone_code, assigned_units FROM warehouse_bin_assignments) AS assignments ORDER BY catalog.bin_id

checks.sql: SELECT bin_id, zone_code, assigned_units FROM warehouse_bin_catalog NATURAL LEFT JOIN warehouse_bin_assignments ORDER BY bin_id
